ink-muted.contrast: 6.4:1 on paper (light), 7.1:1 (dark) — the floor for any real text

ink-faint.contrast: 3.3:1 — rules, list markers, non-text glyphs only

accent.usage: New-post indicator dot; invalid-input state of the Gershgorin matrix field. Nowhere else.

plot-1.usage: Data visualization only — Gershgorin disc overprint.

plot-2.usage: Data visualization only — Gershgorin disc overprint.

plot-3.usage: Data visualization only — Gershgorin disc overprint.

display.purpose: The one h1 per page: post title, index title, home statement. Bodoni Moda with variable optical size.

headline.purpose: h1/h2 inside prose. 56px above, 16px below, so sections read as grouped.

title.purpose: Post-row links in every list and h3 in prose. The display face at body size is what makes a list read as a contents page.

lede.purpose: Single standfirst paragraph under a page h1, capped at 46ch, in muted ink.

body.purpose: All prose and all sentence-length copy, capped at the 64ch measure.

label.purpose: The metadata voice: dates, nav, kind markers, table headers, captions. One to three words only.

label-micro.purpose: Tags and dense-row kind markers at 11px, where 0.14em tracking would break the word apart.

wordmark.purpose: 꼬깜 only. The one place the body face is set bold; Pretendard is used because it is the only face here that draws Korean.

motion.name: link-underline
motion.purpose: The only decoration in the system: a hairline underline that darkens to full ink on hover.

motion.name: state-color
motion.purpose: Nav, tag, and footer links move between muted and full ink on hover; nothing else changes.

motion.name: disclosure-marker
motion.purpose: The tag index's fold marker. The only rotation in the build.

focus.name: focus-visible
focus.purpose: One focus token used everywhere; no component defines its own.

accessibility.minimumInteractiveTarget: 24px, met by padding rather than by a visible box
accessibility.codeThemes: github-light-high-contrast / github-dark-high-contrast, chosen because the standard GitHub themes fall under 4.5:1 on --paper-sunk

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Lowercase mono section link in the masthead; active state is full ink, not a bar or a background.
components.html: blogtilabout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: var(--font-mono, "Spline Sans Mono", monospace); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-muted, #5c5c5c); text-decoration: none; padding: 8px; border-radius: 0; transition: color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #111111); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: var(--ink, #111111); }

components.name: Wordmark with New-Post Indicator
components.description: The site name in Korean, carrying the system's only use of the accent: a 5px dot when a section has a post from the last month.
components.html: 꼬깜 — new blog post
components.css: .ds-wordmark { position: relative; font-family: var(--font-body, "Pretendard Variable", sans-serif); font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.05rem + 0.32vw, 1.3125rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--ink, #111111); text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #111111); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-wordmark-dot { position: absolute; right: -10px; top: -2px; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent, #d93a1e); } .ds-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Post Row

components.css: .ds-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-row { display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 24px; align-items: baseline; padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #e3e3e1); } .ds-row-date { flex-shrink: 0; width: 6.5rem; font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-muted, #5c5c5c); font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1; } .ds-row-main { min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-row-title { display: block; font-family: var(--font-display, Georgia, serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: clamp(1.0625rem, 1rem + 0.3vw, 1.25rem); line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink, #111111); text-decoration: none; } .ds-row-title:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--rule-strong, #c9c9c6); text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-row-title:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #111111); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-row-excerpt { margin: 4px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-body, sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--ink-muted, #5c5c5c); }

components.name: Tag Filter
components.description: A tag is microtype, not a chip: no background, no border, no radius. Selection is full ink plus an underline.
components.css: .ds-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 2px 6px; } .ds-tag { font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-muted, #5c5c5c); background: none; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-tag:hover { color: var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-tag:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #111111); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-tag--on { color: var(--ink, #111111); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; }

components.name: Label
components.description: The metadata voice itself: mono, uppercase, 0.14em, muted ink at full contrast. One to three words only.
components.css: .ds-label { font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-muted, #5c5c5c); font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1; } .ds-label--strong { color: var(--ink, #111111); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The build's one text field: sunk paper, hairline border, 2px radius, mono. Invalid swaps the border and message to the accent.
components.html: Must be a square JSON array of numbers
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-muted, #5c5c5c); } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--paper-sunk, #f4f4f3); color: var(--ink, #111111); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e3e3e1); border-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #111111); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--accent, #d93a1e); } .ds-field-error { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--accent, #d93a1e); }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: Sunk paper inside a hairline with a mono line-number gutter at the text contrast floor. Depth without a shadow.
components.css: .ds-pre { background: var(--paper-sunk, #f4f4f3); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e3e3e1); border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px 0; margin: 28px 0; overflow-x: auto; font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--ink, #111111); scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: var(--rule-strong, #c9c9c6) transparent; } .ds-pre code { display: grid; counter-reset: line; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-line { padding: 0 16px; counter-increment: line; } .ds-line::before { content: counter(line); display: inline-block; width: 1.4rem; margin-right: 16px; text-align: right; color: var(--ink-muted, #5c5c5c); user-select: none; font-size: 0.85em; }

components.name: Prose Link
components.description: The only decoration in the system: a hairline underline in rule-strong that darkens to full ink on hover.
components.html: Everything ships as prerendered HTML plus assets in public/.
components.css: .ds-prose { font-family: var(--font-body, sans-serif); font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.96rem + 0.18vw, 1.125rem); line-height: 1.72; color: var(--ink, #111111); max-width: 64ch; } .ds-link { color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--rule-strong, #c9c9c6); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; transition: text-decoration-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #111111); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
This is a reading surface built out of paper, ink, and one hairline. Nothing is boxed, nothing is filled, nothing is lifted. Hierarchy is carried entirely by typographic register — a didone serif for what is being read, a tracked uppercase mono for what is being read about — and by a single 1px rule that separates rows, headers, and footers. There is no card, no pill, no chip, and no shadow anywhere in the build; a grep across src/ and globals.css returns zero box-shadow declarations and zero background-filled metadata.

The density is editorial rather than app-like. One measure (64ch, tuned by counting rendered characters-per-line at ~72) governs the header, the main column, and the footer alike, so the page reads as one column of set text with rules across it rather than as a shell containing content. Type is fluid per role — every step is a clamp() travelling between a 375px and a 1280px viewport — so nothing snaps at a breakpoint. Light and dark are peer themes declared through prefers-color-scheme and color-scheme, not a toggle bolted onto a light design.

The confirmed rejection is the Tailwind-blog default: gray pills for tags, bold sans headings, and metadata faded until it fails contrast. The system's answer to all three is the same move — metadata recedes by register (small, mono, uppercase, tracked) while staying at full contrast, never by dropping toward the background.
keyCharacteristics: Near-white paper / near-black ink; a single accent that is nearly absent.
One hairline weight (1px) in two strengths; zero shadows, zero filled chips.
Three type roles — didone display, mono label, Pretendard body — where the body face also backs the other two stacks because it is the only one that draws Korean.
Fluid clamp() scale per role, 375px → 1280px, no breakpoint steps.
One 64ch measure shared by header, content, and footer.
Contrast floor enforced by token: --ink-muted is the least any real text may be.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red is a state, never a decoration. It is allowed on exactly two things in the shipped build: the new-post indicator dot and the invalid-input state of the Gershgorin matrix field. It never appears on links, buttons, headings, tags, or hovers. If a new surface wants red for emphasis, the answer is the display face, not the accent.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: --ink-muted is the darkest a piece of real text is ever allowed to get. --ink-faint is reserved for rules, list markers, and non-text glyphs. Metadata recedes by typographic register — smaller, mono, uppercase, tracked — never by moving toward the background.

rules.name: The Data-Ink Rule
rules.body: The --plot-* group is scoped to data visualization. It is not a UI palette; no button, badge, link, or heading may draw from it.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Display serif announces, mono annotates, Pretendard reads. A piece of text picks exactly one. There is no bold-sans heading anywhere in this system.

rules.name: The Label Length Rule
rules.body: The label voice is for one to three words. Sentence-length copy — excerpts, ledes, descriptions, captions — stays in the body face at --ink-muted, because 0.14em tracking on a sentence stops being a label and starts being unreadable.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: 64ch (--measure) is the width of the site, not just of the prose. Header, main, and footer all share it, so the hairlines line up top to bottom.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing in this system casts a shadow, and nothing moves on the z-axis. If an element needs to read as separate, give it a hairline or the sunk paper tone. If it needs to read as active, give it full ink.

rules.name: The One Hairline Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one border weight in the system: 1px. Emphasis is a change of color (--rule → --rule-strong → --ink), never of thickness.

dos: Do express metadata as .label — 12px Spline Sans Mono, uppercase, 0.14em, --ink-muted, tabular figures — and mark the active one with label-strong.
Do set every title and heading in the display face via .title-display (Bodoni Moda 500, −0.02em, 1.04, balanced wrap).
Do separate things with a 1px hairline in --rule, escalating to --rule-strong and then --ink for emphasis.
Do keep every column inside the shared 64ch --measure, with a 24px gutter.
Do give interactive text at least 24px of hit area through padding, and leave the padding invisible.
Do use the one :focus-visible token everywhere: 2px solid --focus, 3px offset, 1px radius.
Do read colors from CSS custom properties at draw time in canvas work, so both themes are served by one code path.
Do state dates as ISO yyyy-MM-dd in the mono voice with tnum on, so columns of dates align.
donts: Don't add a shadow. There are none in the build, and depth is a hairline or the sunk paper tone.
Don't put a filled background behind a tag, kind marker, date, or status word. Tags are microtype, not chips.
Don't set a heading in a bold sans. The display serif is the only heading voice.
Don't drop text below --ink-muted to make it recede; change its register instead. --ink-faint is for rules, markers, and non-text only.
Don't spend the accent on anything but the new-post indicator and a genuine invalid state.
Don't pull --plot-1/2/3 into UI chrome; they exist to separate overlapping data and nothing else.
Don't apply .label to sentence-length copy — one to three words is the limit of the tracked voice.
Don't introduce a second border weight or a general-purpose corner radius; square is the default and radius is reserved for depicted objects.
Don't re-enable @tailwindcss/typography; .prose is hand-authored so no upstream defaults can leak past these tokens.
